# Logistics 0.2.1-beta.2

- Promotes the verified 0.2.1 alpha fixes to beta, including a native Transfers screen, transfer history and resumable downloads.
- Simplifies mobile File Browser actions, moves saved documents under Libraries, and improves the file tiles and Settings Back transition.
- Improves AirPlay recovery after wake and resolves the HEVC segment error seen in the reported Apple TV session.
